blocklistGenerator.desc: Generate your own DNS blocklist for your server. Configure filters to match your preferences and start blocking exactly what you want.

meshcorePolska.desc: A Polish community building an independent LoRa mesh radio network - no internet or cellular coverage required. Hardware, antenna, and firmware documentation, plus a Discord server for operators.

sniffcat.desc: Analyze and report malicious IP addresses. Check reputation and download blocklists for firewalls. No tracking, no hidden costs.

cloudflareWaf.desc: Production-ready Cloudflare WAF rules and an auto-update script. Block bots, scrapers, and malicious requests before they reach your origin server.

sefinekDnsBlocklists.desc: DNS blocklists for Pi-hole, AdGuard, Dnsmasq, Unbound, and more. Multiple formats, a whitelist system to reduce false positives, and updates every 3 hours. +45M requests served this year.

maliciousIpAddresses.desc: A list of IP addresses linked to botnets, cyberattacks, and bot traffic. Intended only for traffic classification - not for blocking.

trustedIpsWhitelist.desc: A list of IP addresses used by legitimate crawlers and services: Googlebot, Bingbot, Cloudflare, Stripe, UptimeRobot, and more.

tempEmailDomains.desc: A list of domains used by temporary/disposable email inboxes. Useful for filtering signups, blocking spam, and validating addresses.

sefinekApi.desc: A free REST API for developers. Random images, data, and utilities. Most endpoints require no authorization.

esp32Monitoring.desc: Live environmental monitoring from the West Pomeranian Voivodeship in Poland. Temperature, humidity, pressure, and light served via an ESP32-S3 board and connected sensors.

vstarcamEye4Viewer.desc: A local SD card viewer for Vstarcam / Eye4 cameras. Browse, filter, and play back recordings without the cloud or a mobile app.

malkontenci.desc: A humorous parody of a psychology clinic. A 20-question test that sorts you into one of five types of complainers - pure satire, zero seriousness.

genshinStellaMod.desc: Better graphics and a way to unlock the 60 FPS cap in Genshin Impact. Play smoothly with significantly better visuals. A solid community and a 4.8-star rating on Trustpilot.
